About Us

 

Welcome to Jersey Orbit

The Center of Your Football Universe.

Football isn’t just a game. It’s the 90th-minute winner, the roar of the stadium, the badge over your heart, and the memories that last a lifetime. At Jersey Orbit, we believe that the kit you wear should match the passion you feel.

We didn't just start a store; we started a movement to elevate football culture in India.

Our Story

Jersey Orbit was born out of a simple desire: to bring the world-class football experience closer to home. We realized that true fans deserve jerseys that look and feel professional, without barriers.

We set out on a mission to bridge the gap between passion and performance. We curate only the finest jerseys—pieces that capture the spirit of the sport. From the precise stitching of the crest to the breathable, match-ready fabric, we ensure that every fan can wear their colors with pride.

What We Stand For

1. Elite Craftsmanship

Quality is non-negotiable. We are obsessed with the details. Whether it’s the texture of the fabric or the durability of the print, every jersey in our 24/25 collection is selected to meet high standards. We provide gear that looks just as good in the streets as it does on the pitch.

2. The Perfect Fit

We know that a jersey is more than just a shirt; it’s an identity. That’s why we focus heavily on fit and comfort. Our jerseys are designed to offer an athletic, comfortable fit that moves with you.

3. Driven by Passion

We are based in Kerala, a land where football is a religion. We understand the anticipation of a new season and the excitement of a new kit. That’s why we work tirelessly to get your orders delivered fast and efficiently across India.

Why Choose Jersey Orbit?

  • Curated Excellence: We don't just sell jerseys; we celebrate them. We bring you the latest drops and the most sought-after designs.

  • Fan-First Approach: We are football fans first, retailers second. We speak your language, understand your needs, and share your excitement for the beautiful game.

  • Reliability: When you shop with us, you are choosing a brand that values trust and customer satisfaction above all else.
